Title: Add discount codes at checkout
Body:
Shoppers can now enter a discount code at checkout.

## What's in it

- **`cart/discount.go`**: the `Discount` type and the live codes. A code takes a percentage off the subtotal, can require a minimum subtotal, and expires.
- **`Cart.ApplyDiscount`** checks the code (known, not expired, cart at its minimum) and puts it on the cart. A cart holds one code; applying another replaces it.
- **`Cart.Total`** takes the savings off the subtotal before adding shipping.
- **`POST /cart/discount`** applies a code: 404 for an unknown code, 422 for an expired one or a cart below the minimum. The cart view gains `code` and `savings`.
- `server.New` takes a clock, so the tests can pin the date codes expire by.

## Testing

`go test ./...`: table tests for `ApplyDiscount` (percent off, any case, below the minimum, expired, unknown) and two endpoint tests.
